name: JSP Pharmaceutical Manufacturing (Thailand) Public Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, JSP Pharmaceutical Manufacturing (Thailand) Public Co., Ltd. specializes in providing contract manufacturing services. The company produces a diverse range of products, including dietary supplements, cosmetics, herbal remedies, nutritional products, and pharmaceutical goods within Thailand. Beyond manufacturing, JSP also offers comprehensive support services, encompassing research and development, packaging solutions, and regulatory registration assistance for both pharmaceuticals and dietary supplements. Additionally, the firm manufactures various cleaning products, such as hand sprays and specialized pharmaceutical sanitizers.
